text: The subject Hina Yousaf holds account PK**HABB****7792 which was opened on 4 December 2020. The subject is declared as a Student with a declared monthly income of PKR 25,000 per month. During the activity window from 2 May 2026 to 11 May 2026 the account recorded 19 credits totalling PKR 979,000 and 4 debits totalling PKR 850,000. The credits arrived via 19 interbank (IBFT) transfers from 15 distinct senders. The activity was flagged by Tazama on 11 May 2026, with the typology MULE-01 scoring 360 against a threshold of 300. Many unrelated inbound senders are indicated by the 15 distinct senders, a pattern consistent with money mule activity. The account activity appears inconsistent with the customer profile, as credits were 39.2 times the declared monthly income of PKR 25,000 for a Student. Overall, the pattern is consistent with suspected money mule activity given the multiple senders, rapid outflow, and mismatch with the declared Student income of PKR 25,000 per month. PKR 572,000 was sent to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (WLT****0932, Synthetic EMI) in 3 transactions. PKR 278,000 was withdrawn as Cash (ATM) in 1 transaction. Screening on 29 May 2026 found no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media lists. Outgoing wallet transfers were placed on hold pending review, with no contact made with the customer about this review.
